label: Sniper Rifle
note: IP-neutral. Generic label only. The rifle blaster's numbers with heavy damage (150: one shot drops a trooper), a fast bolt and a long reach, so scoped in it lands dead on the crosshair at 100 m and more. Not scoped in, 'hip_spread_deg' throws each shot up to 3 degrees off (scope it to snipe). 'rate' 0.24 s between shots, half the old pace, and slower than the rifle blaster. Sold only by the fence (vendors/fence.json); items/sniper_rifle.json 'must_own' keeps it holstered until you have bought it, in free roam too.
